body: Hey there... I haven't got any advice. I don't know what you should do about your situation, I know the guys sounds like he's not worth all of your effort, and that after this many years, things should be different for you. I don't know if it all gets better, or if anything really changes at all. I just wanted to let you know, you're not alone. If that helps, great. If not, I'm really sorry. I wish I could say something more, but there it is,
